request: Explain when to run the security scan during project setup.
scope: The first-run interview and subsequent make init invocations.
setup: Use a marked template checkout with Python, Git and Make.
constraints: Scan committed files and preserve the one-time setup behavior.

steps.action: Show the next assurance command after successful setup and on a repeat invocation.

verify.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_template.py -k test_make_init
verify.expected: A completed setup explains how to scan a commit. An interrupted setup preserves the original files.

acceptance.when: Initialize the project and run make init a second time.
acceptance.then: The first run tells the user to commit before scanning. The second points to the current commit and preserves the profile.

acceptance.when: Submit incomplete or invalid setup answers.
acceptance.then: Setup fails, keeps the marker and original files, and omits the post-commit instructions.
